decisions.reason: It is tightly linked to the firm's owned metro, data-centre and cloud-connectivity assets, and prior visible adoption reinforces management's commitment to continue rather than reverse course.

The portal supports the firm's announced move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning, so sunk development effort and strategic fit make retention more likely even if results are not prominently visible.

Although enterprise voice is less central to future growth than cloud and high-bandwidth infrastructure, it still complements the core network business and existing customer relationships, which encourages management to persist for now.
